name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana (PM-MKSSY)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
brief: The "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana (PM-MKSSY)" is being implemented by the Ministry of Fisheries Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Department of Fisheries, Government of India as the Central Sector Sub-Scheme…
briefFull: The scheme aims to provide financial incentives to persons associated with fisheries and aquaculture for registration, successful loan facilitation, and aquaculture insurance. It promotes capital investment, job creation, and employment retention through performance-based grants.
details:
The "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana (PM-MKSSY)" is being implemented by the Ministry of Fisheries Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Department of Fisheries, Government of India as the Central Sector Sub-Scheme under the ongoing PMMSY for a period of four years in all the States and Union Territories.
> **Objectives:**

- Gradual Formalisation of fisheries sector by creating work-based Identities for fishers, fish farmers and other stakeholders under a National Fisheries Digital Platform (NFDP).
- Facilitating access to institutional finance.
- Incentivization of adoption of aquaculture insurance.
- Incentivizing fisheries Microenterprises for improving fisheries sector value chain efficiencies through Performance Grant.
- Incentivizing micro and small fisheries enterprises for adoption and expansion of fish and fishery product safety and quality assurance systems.
benefits:
- Persons Associated with Fisheries and Aquaculture will get a Certificate of Registration along with ₹ 100 after successful completion of one-time registration process on the NFDP platform providing all necessary documents and information as per the approved operational guidelines. 
- Individuals Associated with Fisheries and Aquaculture will get success fees of ₹ 3000 to ₹ 5000 (depending on the loan amount) for successful loan after approval of the loan application and loan disbursement by the bank, the Stakeholder will upload the loan approval letter and documents supporting loan disbursement to the beneficiary on the NFDP.
- Individuals Associated with Aquaculture will get One time Aquaculture Insurance Incentive upon paid premium purchase of the insurance policy; the insured shall submit a claim for availing the “one-time incentive” on NFDP, against the purchase of aquaculture insurance as per the approved operational guidelines. 
- Fisheries and Aquaculture Stakeholder will get Performance grant towards the incentive through respective component under Component 2 & 3 of the PM-MKSSY against the Capital Investment and Job Creation / maintenance as per the approved Operational guidelines.
eligibility:
1. Fisheries and Aquaculture Stakeholder (Individual and organisations) involved in the fisheries value chain shall be eligible for registration on the NFDP.
1. Fisheries and Aquaculture Stakeholder involved in the fisheries value chain shall be eligible for one time success fees on successful disbursement of loan amount.
1. Fisheries and Aquaculture farmers having up to 4hectares aquaculture farm size or equivalent unit shall be eligible for one time aquaculture insurance incentive.
1. Fisheries and Aquaculture Stakeholder (Micro and Small Enterprises) will get Performance grant under Component 2 & 3 of the PM-MKSSY against the Investment and Job Creation /maintenance as per the approved Operational guidelines.
howToApply:
[Online]
> **Registration Process: Apply as an Individual/Organization**

**Step 01:** Select [**New User Registration**](https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp/#/registration) from the top menu or from the Apply for Sub-scheme Benefits under PM-MKSSY section on the Home Page.
**Step 02:** Click Apply as an Individual/Organization button as per your Profile.
**Step 03:** Enter Aadhaar Number or Pan card Number. Check consent box, click on 'Validate Aadhaar' button.
**Step 04:** Enter OTP received on Aadhaar linked mobile number. Click on validate button. After successful validation next screen will ask for Mobile number.
**Step 05:** Enter mobile number. Enter Captcha. Click on Next button.
**Step 06:** Enter OTP received on mobile number. Click on validate button. After successful validation, the NFDP Registration form will open.
**Step 07:** Fill in the complete Registration details. as per your profile: Personal/Organization Information, Address, Occupation & Bank Details & submit.
**Step 08:** Note your NFDP Registration Number and download your Provisional NFDP Registration certificate by clicking the Download Certificate button.
> **Login Process:**

**Beneficiary Login**- [https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp_benificary/#/login](https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp_benificary/#/login)
**Credit Facilitation**- [https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp/#/credit-facilitation](https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp/#/credit-facilitation)
**Aquaculture Insurance**- [https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp/#/insurance](https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp/#/insurance)
**Performance grant**- [https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp_benificary/#/performance-grant](https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp_benificary/#/performance-grant)

[Online - via CSC]
**Step 01:** The interested eligible applicant must visit their nearest [Common Service Centre](https://locator.csccloud.in/) (CSC) to initiate the registration process offline. 
**Step 02:** The applicant must carry prerequisites such as their Aadhaar Card and evidence of their bank account, etc.
documentsRequired:
- Mobile linked Aadhar Number and Bank account details.
- Loan Disbursement Certificate from Bank or Loan account statement.
- Details of Aquaculture Insurance Policy details and Farm Size, Social Category etc. and Valid Bank account details.

faqs.q: Who can register on the National Fisheries Digital Platform (NFDP)?
faqs.a: Fisheries and aquaculture stakeholders, including individuals and organizations involved in the fisheries value chain, can register on NFDP.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for the loan success fee?
faqs.a: Fisheries and aquaculture stakeholders involved in the fisheries value chain are eligible for the one-time success fee upon successful loan disbursement.

faqs.q: How much success fee is provided for successful loan facilitation?
faqs.a: A success fee of ₹3,000 to ₹5,000 is provided, depending on the loan amount.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for the performance grant?
faqs.a: Micro and small fisheries and aquaculture enterprises involved in the fisheries value chain are eligible for the performance grant under the applicable components of PM-MKSSY.

faqs.q: What documents are required to avail the benefits?
faqs.a: Required documents may include a mobile-linked Aadhaar number, bank account details, loan disbursement certificate or loan account statement, and aquaculture insurance and farm-related details, as applicable.

faqs.q: What is NFDP Registration?
faqs.a: NFDP is developed as a single window registry system for registration of Fishers Community.

faqs.q: Who should register on NFDP?
faqs.a:
All persons, families, groups, businesses (formal or informal) working as employees, service providers and/or owners in the fisheries and aquaculture sectors or the relevant supply chains or value chains. The supply and value chain entities would normally include, but not necessarily limited to, the following:
 i.Platform Registration Module - Fish farmers, fishermen, FFPOs, fish workers, fish vendors, micro and small enterprises
 ii. Workflow Management - DoF, NFDB, States & UTs, World Bank, AFD, NABARD, CSC
 iii. Training Module - Fisheries Institutions
The NFDP registers people/families/groups as enterprises: micro-, small, medium and large enterprises. This is because fishery or aquaculture are basically commercial activities. The sector is dominated by micro-enterprises. It is to be noted that most fishery sector micro-enterprises involve only one main worker, with or without involvement of additional family members and/or part-time employees. The intention is that NFDP should register all such single worker enterprises, all part or full-time family members, and all part or full-time employees of relatively larger business/enterprises.

faqs.q: Is there a need to submit hard copies of any documents?
faqs.a: No. The new registration process is paperless.

faqs.q: If a person doesn?t have a DSC or an Aadhaar Card, can he print the registration application and submit the duly signed hard copies via speed post or in person?
faqs.a: No paper-based application will not be accepted for NFDP registration. It is mandatory for the applicant to obtain a an Aadhaar card for validation.

faqs.q: Is there any prescribed format for documents/photographs that need to be uploaded when applying for a new registration for NFDP?
faqs.a: Yes, all documents that are uploaded must be scanned and in JPG/ PDF format. The file size must be less than 1500 KB.

faqs.q: If document/ photograph is not in the prescribed format or permitted file size. What to do?
faqs.a: User applicants may use online tools available on the internet to convert the document/photograph into the prescribed format/size.

faqs.q: Is there any verification while filing the new registration application?
faqs.a: Yes, One Time Passwords (OTP) will be sent on the applicant?s mobile number as well as the e-mail ID selected for the purpose of registration.

faqs.q: Is there a provision to save a new NFDP registration application?
faqs.a: Yes, after filling in the details the user can save the application using the tab 'Save as Draft'. The system will generate a 'Registration Number' that can be used for accessing the draft in future.

faqs.q: For how long one can access a previously saved registration application?
faqs.a: Registration Number, generated during the process is valid for 15 days. User will have to complete the registration process i.e., submit the registration form within the said expiry period. Failing to do so will result in deletion of the Registration ID from records and user will have to re-initiate the process from the beginning.

faqs.q: How to track the status of a registration application?
faqs.a: Registrants can check through registration number.

faqs.q: How much time will it take for a registration to be processed?
faqs.a: On successful submission of an application, processing of the application would be completed in 3-4 working days. Once the application is approved, NFDP User ID and Password would be sent on the registered e-mail ID/mobile no. But, due to any reason if the application is rejected, the reasons for the rejection of the application wouldalso be informed via the registered email ID/SMS.

faqs.q: Application for NFDP Registration Number is still pending approval after 3-4 working days. What should be done?
faqs.a: Officers occasionally require additional verification to process the IDs. Validating the documents submitted might take a little bit longer than the mentioned timeframe. However, in case of undue delay, user applicant may contact the NFDP Helpdesk or email

faqs.q: Can the assessing officer reject a registration application?
faqs.a:
Yes, an NFDP registration application can be rejected in the following scenarios:
(i) Copy of Aadhaar is not clear/ proper, or not self-attested.
(ii) Does not belong to Fisherman Community

faqs.q: What is to be done on getting the error ? 'Please check your credentials'
faqs.a: Kindly double-check the entered details. If the details are correct and the issue persists, please contact helpdesk for assistance.

faqs.q: How is my data secured?
faqs.a: The NFDP is committed to protecting the privacy of its users.Ensuring the NFDP Portal complies with all relevant Indian data protection laws and regulations, such as the Information Technology Act, 2000 and any amendments. Byimplementing data protection measures such as unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration,destruction, the NFDP Portal can safeguard user privacy, build trust, and ensure responsible use of data for a flourishing fisheries sector.
